action_instruction: Reading the shopper email from the header
intent: the shopper email shown in the header account link

action_params.condition: the header shows the shopper's email (equals)
action_params.query: the shopper email shown in the header account link

action_instruction: Checking whether the shopper is signed in for checkout
intent: whether the shopper is recognized as signed in for checkout from the header account link

action_params.condition: a new shopper who signs up with an email and password becomes recognized as signed in for checkout
action_params.query: whether the shopper is recognized as signed in for checkout from the header account link

assertion_tree.description: the header shows the shopper's email (equals), confirming that a new shopper who signs up with an email and password becomes recognized as signed in for checkout

sub_results.description: the header shows the shopper's email (equals)
a new shopper who signs up with an email and password becomes recognized as signed in for checkout

assertion_tree.verification: The header displays the shopper's email and indicates the shopper is recognized as signed in for checkout after sign-up.
